Sofia Ramirez

Oh wow, that sounds amazing! I love that combination—aesthetics AND physics together. I have to admit, I don't know much about sustainable building design yet, but I'm really curious. That's so cool! A 1970s office building retrofit—I'm already trying to imagine what that would look like. Thank you so much for explaining all of this, Professor Tanaka. I feel way less nervous about jumping into a topic I don't know much about yet. And I'm definitely going to have questions! I really appreciate how welcoming you are about that.
